7 انبرى , (K, TA,) or ↓ ابترى , (so in a copy of the M,) It was, or became, formed, or fashioned, by cutting; shaped out; or pared: (M, K:) said of a reed for writing, and of a stick, or piece of wood, (M,) and of an arrow, (M, K,) &c. (M.) ＝
-A2- See also 3: ―
-b2- and see 5, in six places.
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
